prompt: We are a fintech licensed by SAMA. Do the NCA Essential Cybersecurity Controls also apply to us, or only the SAMA framework? What maturity level do we need?
assertions: Answers the stacking question correctly: SAMA CSF applies to all SAMA-regulated entities (including licensed fintechs); NCA ECC additionally applies only if the entity owns/operates/hosts Critical National Infrastructure — the regimes stack rather than displace, and the answer must not claim ECC is mandatory for every fintech
States the SAMA CSF structure accurately: 4 domains (Leadership & Governance; Risk Management & Compliance; Operations & Technology; Third-Party Cyber Security)
States the maturity expectation correctly: 6-level maturity model (0-5) with SAMA expecting minimum maturity level 3
Notes that PDPL applies in parallel for customer personal data (SDAIA, distinct from SAMA)

Gives practical unify-and-map advice: maintain one internal control set mapped to both SAMA CSF and ECC (if CNI) rather than duplicate programmes, and confirm CNI designation status rather than assuming
